mapper.select: select count(1) from xf_work_order w left join xf_uniform_style st on w.style_id = st.style_id where st.season = #{seasonCode}

select season_code from ( select st.season as season_code, count(1) as total_count from xf_work_order w left join xf_uniform_style st on w.style_id = st.style_id where st.season is not null and st.season != '' group by st.season union all select st.season as season_code, 1 as total_count from xf_uniform_style st where st.season is not null and st.season != '' ) season_stat group by season_code order by sum(total_count) desc, season_code asc limit 1

select ( select count(distinct concat_ws('|', m.school_name, m.class_name, case when ifnull(m.student_no, '') = '' then m.student_name else m.student_no end)) from xf_measure_record m ) as protectedStudents, ( select ifnull(sum(s.total_quantity), 0) from xf_shipment_order s left join xf_work_order w on s.work_order_id = w.work_order_id left join xf_uniform_style st on w.style_id = st.style_id where st.season = #{seasonCode} ) as seasonalDeliveryQuantity, ( select count(distinct w.school_name) from xf_work_order w left join xf_uniform_style st on w.style_id = st.style_id where st.season = #{seasonCode} ) as activeSchools, ( select ifnull(sum(case when q.result = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) from xf_quality_inspection q left join xf_work_order w on q.work_order_id = w.work_order_id left join xf_uniform_style st on w.style_id = st.style_id where st.season = #{seasonCode} ) as qualityPassCount, ( select count(1) from xf_quality_inspection q left join xf_work_order w on q.work_order_id = w.work_order_id left join xf_uniform_style st on w.style_id = st.style_id where st.season = #{seasonCode} ) as qualityInspectCount

select q.inspection_id as inspectionId, q.inspection_no as inspectionNo, w.school_name as schoolName, st.style_name as styleName, mb.batch_no as batchNo, q.gb_standard as gbStandard, q.result as result, q.conclusion as conclusion, q.inspect_time as inspectTime, q.formaldehyde as formaldehyde, q.ph_value as phValue, q.odor_result as odorResult, q.amine_result as amineResult, q.color_fastness as colorFastness, q.pilling_grade as pillingGrade from xf_quality_inspection q left join xf_work_order w on q.work_order_id = w.work_order_id left join xf_uniform_style st on w.style_id = st.style_id left join xf_material_batch mb on w.material_batch_id = mb.batch_id where st.season = #{seasonCode} order by q.inspect_time desc, q.inspection_id desc limit 1

select w.order_status as stageCode, count(1) as value from xf_work_order w left join xf_uniform_style st on w.style_id = st.style_id where st.season = #{seasonCode} group by w.order_status order by w.order_status asc
mapper.sql: select s.school_name, ifnull(sum(s.total_quantity), 0) as total_quantity, ifnull(sum(s.packed_quantity), 0) as packed_quantity, ifnull(sum(case when s.shipment_status = '4' then s.total_quantity else 0 end), 0) as signed_quantity, cast(max(cast(ifnull(s.shipment_status, '0') as unsigned)) as char) as shipment_status from xf_shipment_order s left join xf_work_order w on s.work_order_id = w.work_order_id left join xf_uniform_style st on w.style_id = st.style_id where st.season = #{seasonCode} group by s.school_name
mapper.select:
select concat(r.source_name, ' -> ', r.target_name) as routeName, r.source_name as sourceName, r.source_lng as sourceLng, r.source_lat as sourceLat, r.target_name as targetName, r.target_lng as targetLng, r.target_lat as targetLat, ifnull(agg.total_quantity, 0) as shipmentQuantity, ifnull(agg.packed_quantity, 0) as packedQuantity, round( case when ifnull(agg.total_quantity, 0) = 0 then 0 else agg.packed_quantity * 100 / agg.total_quantity end, 1 ) as progressRate from xf_screen_route_config r left join (
) agg on agg.school_name = r.target_name where r.route_status = '0' order by shipmentQuantity desc, r.route_id asc

select r.target_name as schoolName, ifnull(agg.total_quantity, 0) as totalQuantity, ifnull(agg.packed_quantity, 0) as packedQuantity, ifnull(agg.signed_quantity, 0) as signedQuantity, round( case when ifnull(agg.total_quantity, 0) = 0 then 0 else agg.packed_quantity * 100 / agg.total_quantity end, 1 ) as progressRate, round( case when ifnull(agg.total_quantity, 0) = 0 then 0 else agg.signed_quantity * 100 / agg.total_quantity end, 1 ) as signRate, agg.shipment_status as shipmentStatus from xf_screen_route_config r left join (
) agg on agg.school_name = r.target_name where r.route_status = '0' order by progressRate desc, totalQuantity desc, schoolName asc

select f.keyword_tag as name, count(1) as value from xf_parent_feedback f where f.sentiment = '1' and ifnull(f.keyword_tag, '') != '' group by f.keyword_tag order by value desc, avg(f.score) desc, f.keyword_tag asc limit 12

select body_type as name, count(1) as value from ( select case when m.height_value is null or m.height_value = 0 or m.weight_value is null then '待完善' when m.weight_value / ((m.height_value / 100) * (m.height_value / 100)) < 18.5 then '偏瘦' when m.weight_value / ((m.height_value / 100) * (m.height_value / 100)) < 24 then '标准' when m.weight_value / ((m.height_value / 100) * (m.height_value / 100)) < 27 then '微胖' else '壮实' end as body_type from xf_measure_record m left join xf_uniform_style st on m.style_id = st.style_id where st.season = #{seasonCode} ) body_stat group by body_type order by value desc, name asc
